title: fix(app-shell): stop reading the retired `flow-template` ledger role in slotsForType (objectui#12170)
body:
Fixes #12170
Clause-②: no

## What and why

`Spec Main Shape Gate` fails every objectui pull request with TS2367 in `slotsForType` (`packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/flow-node-refs.ts`), on the line `else if (entry.role === 'flow-template') slots.template.push(at);`. The cause is objectstack-ai/objectstack#22883 (`9fdb12752c`, stage S3 of objectstack-ai/objectstack#19939 pass 4). It retired the ledger role `flow-template` and moved its two rows of `FLOW_NODE_EXPRESSION_PATHS`, `loop.collection` and `map.collection`, to `value`. That leaves `FlowNodeExpressionRole = 'predicate' | 'value'` on spec `main`.

This PR deletes that branch and corrects the module comment's dialect list, which named "a ledger `flow-template` slot". It does not keep the comparison alive with a cast. `slotsForType` now compiles against both the installed spec (17.7.0, which still declares `flow-template`) and spec `main`. `git grep flow-template` over the tree now returns no hits. At the base it returned two, both in this file: the comment and the branch.

Out of scope, as the card says: the designer's two `collection` fields, `json-schema-to-fields.ts`, and the test data in `FlowNodeInspector.loopItemVariable-9340`. That designer half is owned by objectui#12101, which stays on hold until an installable spec carries S3.

## Why behaviour does not move at the pin

Measured on the installed spec, not assumed:

- **Ledger rows.** The installed `FLOW_NODE_EXPRESSION_PATHS` has 7 rows: 2 `predicate`, 3 `value`, 2 `flow-template`. The two `flow-template` rows are exactly `loop` `collection` and `map` `collection`.
- **Descriptor.** In `inspectors/flow-node-config.ts`, both the `loop` entry and the `map` entry declare `cfg('collection', 'Collection', 'expression', { … refMode: 'template' … })`. So the descriptor loop in `slotsForType` already pushes `['collection']` into `slots.template` for both node types, and the deleted branch pushed the same pattern a second time.
- **Without the descriptor.** Rule 5 of the module comment (the `walkValue` fallthrough) would still read `collection` as a template, because the key is neither `condition` nor `expression`.
- **The ledger branch could never decide this slot.** `walkValue` tests `slots.cel` before `slots.template`. Where a descriptor says CEL, a ledger template entry cannot override it. Where it says template, the entry adds nothing. Ablation leg C below measures this.
- **On spec `main`** the two rows are `value`. `slotsForType` already leaves `value` to the value itself (an envelope is read by its own dialect, a string is a template), so behaviour is the same there too.

## Tests (HEAD `9432f12`)

- The existing control is unchanged and green: the case "a {{ x.at | date }} hole, a CEL value envelope and a loop's collection follow too".
- A new case pins the map beside the loop: "a loop's and a map's collection are templates by their descriptor, and a map's follows a rename too (objectui#12170)". It asserts that `exprSites` gives dialect `template` for both `collection` strings, and that a rename carries the map's `{x.items}` hole.
- Build closure ①: `turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/app-shell^...' --concurrency=2` passed, 28 of 28 tasks (all cache hits), through the verify lock.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` exited 0. The script name `type-check` was echoed, and it ran `tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`. The test project's `include` is `src/**/*.test.ts`, which covers the edited test file.
- Targeted vitest, run from the repo root: 5 files, 65 tests passed. The files are `flow-node-refs.renameExprRefs-11838.test.ts`, `flow-expr-problems.test.ts`, `flow-problems.removalRefusal-11838.test.ts`, `FlowPreview.nodeIdPositions-11838.test.tsx` and `FlowNodeInspector.renameExprRefs-11838.test.tsx`. That is every test that imports `flow-node-refs`, plus the one the dispatch named.
- ESLint on the two edited TS files: 2 files, 0 errors, 0 warnings, run with `--no-inline-config --format json`. The narrowing to those two files is complete because `eslint.config.js` sets no `parserOptions.project` or `projectService`. Type-aware linting is off, so this diff cannot change the verdict on any file it does not touch.
- Gates: `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`, `pnpm check:changeset-claims`, `pnpm check:pending-changeset-literals`, `pnpm check:control-bytes` and `pnpm check:new-line-citations` all exited 0. The last printed "0 new citation(s)".

**Ablations.** These are one-off runs on the committed HEAD; no test file keeps them. Each leg went through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` from objectstack, where the anchor has to hit and the restore is proven by blob equal to HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`. After every leg the working tree was clean.

| Leg | Mutation | Expected | Observed |
|---|---|---|---|
| A | put the `flow-template` branch back (it compiles at the pin) | no change | 21 of 21 green |
| B | drop `refMode: 'template'` from the `map` `collection` descriptor | the new pin goes red | 1 failed of 21: `{ l: 'template', m: 'cel' }` |
| C | B, plus the `flow-template` branch put back | if the branch had ever decided this slot, green | still red, same `m: 'cel'`, so the branch never decided it |

Two first attempts did nothing: in leg A the replacement contained the anchor, and in leg B the replacement was a substring of the anchor. The tool refused both before running any test, and restored the file. Those attempts measured nothing. The legs were re-run with anchors that did not overlap their replacements.

## The decisive reading

This PR's own `Spec Main Shape Gate` run decides it. In the red run on PR objectui#12167 (check run `114613477132`), both `type-check` and `build` of `@object-ui/app-shell` exited 2. The packages downstream of app-shell were therefore never measured against spec `main`: `@object-ui/console`, `examples/byo-backend-console` and `examples/console-starter`. Nor were app-shell's own tests, because the `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` half of the chain never ran. If the gate names a further file, it is reported back on objectui#12170, not folded in here. I did not reproduce the gate locally, because that needs a forced (uncached) type-check of the app-shell graph. The gate on this PR is the measurement.

## Acceptance notes

- **When the pin moves** (objectui#12101's lane, not this PR), `inspectors/flow-value-envelope.test.ts` will need its ledger read updated. It pins the installed ledger's `value` rows as exactly `assignment:assignments.*`, `create_record:fields.*` and `update_record:fields.*`. On a spec carrying S3, that list gains `loop:collection` and `map:collection`. The Shape Gate compiles only, so it does not see this, and nothing is wrong at the pin today. Owner: objectui#12101.
- `isValueEnvelopeSlot` reads only `KEY.*` ledger paths, so the two new `value` rows (bare `collection`) do not offer the key-value expression toggle on either spec.

## Changeset

`.changeset/12170-flow-template-role.md` has an empty frontmatter, declaring that nothing is released. The change is to a module-private function, and behaviour does not move on either spec.
